test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a circular race of 4225 m, X and Y start from the same point and at the same time at speeds of 54 km/h and 63 km/h. When will they meet again for the first time on the track when they are running in the opposite direction?
solution: Given: X and Y start from the same point and at the same time at speeds of 54 km/h and 63 km/h. Distance = 4225 m **Formula used:** Distance = relative speed × time
